user.title: Entity Inventory
user.description: Exports the Home Assistant structure (areas, devices, entities, possible values) to a YAML file meant to be given to an AI. No states are exported.

data_description.output_path: Path relative to /config or absolute (e.g. /share/entity_inventory.yaml). /config/www is forbidden because it is public.
data_description.include_config: Technical settings (calibration, LED mode, 'check update' buttons…). Rarely useful to write automations, and bulky.
data_description.include_diagnostic: Signal, LQI, voltage, last seen… Batteries are always kept, even when this option is off.
data_description.excluded_integrations: Integrations whose entities will not be exported at all (e.g. proxmoxve, sentinel, sentinel_report). Greatly reduces the file size on large installations.
data_description.redact_emails: Replaces any e-mail address found in a name (account title echoed by a monitoring integration, notifier…) with [email]. Entity IDs are left unchanged.

error.forbidden_www: /config/www is served without authentication: choose another location.

export.name: Export inventory
export.description: Generates the YAML inventory file (structure only, no states) using the configured filters.

validate.name: Validate YAML
validate.description: Checks YAML (automation, script, package) written by an AI: unknown entities and actions, invalid preset/option values, numeric_state on non-numeric entities, legacy syntax. Changes nothing.

yaml.name: YAML
yaml.description: The YAML to check. If it contains Jinja templates (such as trigger.to_state), wrap it in a Jinja "raw … endraw" block (see README), or use "File".

path.name: File
path.description: .yaml file to check, relative to /config (e.g. ai/draft.yaml) or in /share. Templates in it are never rendered.

watchman_scans_export.title: Watchman scans the Entity Inventory export

confirm.title: Add the export to Watchman's ignored files
confirm.description: The export file {path} is inside /config: Watchman scans it and reports the many entities it lists that are normally unknown or unavailable (buttons, scenes, text-to-speech…) as errors. Click Submit to add this file to Watchman's ignored files. If you later change the export path, the fix will be offered again and will replace the old path. Alternatively, choose a path outside /config (e.g. /share/entity_inventory.yaml) in the Entity Inventory options.

abort.unsupported: Watchman's configuration format was not recognised: nothing was changed. Add the path manually in Watchman's options (ignored files).
abort.entry_missing: Entity Inventory is no longer configured.
